raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Replaces the hand-rolled "assign on the first load, `copy_` in place afterwards" pattern with `refill_derived` (#64692) in four more places. Part of RFC #54477, tracker F8. Mirrors aoshen02/vllm#238 (authored by aoshen02), opened against `main`; the branch is two commits on top of upstream main 65a904538d.

## Claims

- `refill_derived` replaces the hand-written pattern in:
  - `finalize_mhc_broadcast_weights` in DeepSeek-V4 NVIDIA and DeepSeek-V4.1 NVIDIA / AMD.
  - `_router_planes` in Muse Spark ROCm.
  - FlashInfer and b12x fp32 attention sinks (#48251). For an fp32 source, `.to(fp32)` returns the source itself, so the `copy_` is a no-op and the alias is kept.
- This is an equivalent rewrite with no behavior change: `refill_derived` copies in place when shape, dtype and device match, and assigns otherwise.
- 6 files, −35 / +14.

## Validation

verda GB300 (jobs 27192, 27193), nightly image with the branch overlaid:

| test | result |
|---|---|
| `tests/kernels/mhc/test_mhc_kernels.py -k broadcast` (includes refreshed in place after refit, same object) | 52 passed |
| `tests/models/test_muse_spark_rocm_loading.py` (`_router_planes` `data_ptr` unchanged) | 13 passed |
| `test_flashinfer_attention_sinks_refreshed_after_reload`, `test_b12x_attention_sinks_refresh_in_place_after_reload` | 4 passed |
| `tests/model_executor/test_utils.py` + `model_loader/test_direct_reload.py` | 68 passed |

Not run: GSM8K pre/post. This is an equivalent rewrite.

## Details

`refill_derived` already implements the in-place-or-assign logic that each of these sites duplicated, so the change deletes the duplicated branches and calls the shared helper.

---
